verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no Skyvern training opt-out, no-training commitment, or data-usage policy. Self-hosting with your own LLM keys or a local model (skyvern-docs-12, skyvern-docs-42) and placeholder credentials (skyvern-docs-36) are adjacent data-control features. Neither is documented as preventing data from being used for model training, so they earn no credit here.
